title: Task bounty paying a graded placement ladder
description: Exercises rewardTiers on bountyKind 'task': the table is required for a security bounty and is the alternative to the scalar reward on a task bounty that grades its payout. Compensation is exactly one of the two, so a graded task carries the table and no scalar — a reward beside the ladder leaves no way to tell whether it means the winner's payout, a base, or the total purse. Tiers here key on label, the selector for a grading axis severity and assetType do not describe.
